say:1:1441112001:1.text: Ravion, I'm not here to lecture you about your questionable private life, nor do I care to deal with your unruly guards.
say:1:1441112001:1.source_cn: 沙利叶，我无意重复你那没有原则的风流引发的诸多舆论，也...

say:2:1441112002:1.text: But seriously, just keep your guards away from my priests, especially those commoners in the mix.
say:2:1441112002:1.source_cn: 只是善意提醒，让你的卫队离我手下的祭司们远些，尤其是那...

say:3:1441112003:1.text: Don't corrupt these pure souls, who see honoring the Queen as the top priority in their lives...
say:3:1441112003:1.source_cn: 不要蛊惑这些纯净的心灵，这些将敬爱女王奉为生命中唯一要...

say:4:1441112004:0.text: My apologies, the presence of my guards has contaminated the air around your esteemed priests.
say:4:1441112004:0.source_cn: 我的卫队玷污了尊贵祭司们周围的空气，这倒是我的疏忽了。

say:5:1441112005:1.text: It isn't easy to become a priest, so it's only right they steer clear of contamination and chaos.
say:5:1441112005:1.source_cn: 每位祭司的培养都极为不易，自然该远离肮脏与混乱。

choice_prompt:6:1441112005.text: It isn't easy to become a priest, so it's only right they steer clear of contamination and chaos.
choice_prompt:6:1441112005.source_cn: 每位祭司的培养都极为不易，自然该远离肮脏与混乱。

say:7:1441112006:1.text: Naturally. A priest needs a noble background, exceptional talent, a fine appearance, and a devout heart—each condition is a must.
say:7:1441112006:1.source_cn: 那是自然。高贵的出身，卓越的天资，美好的仪表，虔信的心...

say:8:1441112007:1.text: Noble children of the right age have to go through rounds of selection, and only the most devout are chosen to serve the Queen.
say:8:1441112007:1.source_cn: 贵族中适龄的孩童，经过层层选拔，最为虔敬者才能以服侍女...

choice_prompt:9:1441112007.text: Noble children of the right age have to go through rounds of selection, and only the most devout are chosen to serve the Queen.
choice_prompt:9:1441112007.source_cn: 贵族中适龄的孩童，经过层层选拔，最为虔敬者才能以服侍女王为天职。

say:10:1441112008:1.source_cn: 这只是他们历练的第一步。

say:11:1441112009:1.text: To ease the people's suffering and clear their confusion, they must perfect their skills in magic, etiquette, and speech.
say:11:1441112009:1.source_cn: 他们要将法术，礼仪，言辞都修习到尽善尽美的地步，如此才...

say:12:1441112010:0.text: So much effort to become a priest! But isn't the bulk of their job just handing out punishments?
say:12:1441112010:0.source_cn: 费这么大劲成为祭司，结果最常干的不就是施加刑罚这样的工作？

say:13:1441112011:1.text: Actually, it pains every priest to punish the people.
say:13:1441112011:1.source_cn: 每位祭司施行惩戒时，内心都怀着极大的悲恸。

say:14:1441112012:1.text: Yet, it's a pain we must endure to bring the confused ones to senses and lead them back to the Queen's gentle embrace.
say:14:1441112012:1.source_cn: 忍耐着这样的悲恸，才能助迷途之人醒悟，重返女王的柔泽之下。

choice:6:0:1.text: Is it hard to become a priest?

choice:6:0:1.female: Is it hard to become a priest?
